senses.gloss: (בִּינִיתָא Ar. s. v. בין2) f. (v. בִּינָא III) thread, a single hair, (collect.) hair.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 20:16">Targ. Jud. XX, 16</cite> <he>בֵּינַת שערא</he>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:7">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>מב׳ דראשי</he> from the hair of my head.
<cite ref="Nazir 39a:6">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>עיקבא דב׳</he> the root of the hair, <he>ריש׳ דב׳</he> the top of &c.—
<cite ref="Yoma 69b:10">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>אשתמיט ב׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בניתה</he>) a hair of his beard fell out.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:13">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כמשחל ב׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>בניתא</he>) as easy as taking a hair out of the milk.—Pl. <cite ref="B00647"><he>בִּינֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> seven cumin seeds (v. <cite ref="B00655">preced.</cite>) and <he>ז׳ ב׳ מדיקנא</he> seven hairs from the beard.—<cite ref="B00654"><he>בִּינָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:17">Targ. Job IX, 17</cite> <he>חוטי ב׳</he> (h. text <cite ref="U01691"><he>שְׂעָרָה</he></cite>!).
